original.target_description: Independent-samples t-test of estimated woman age comparing very-youngest 10% (18–22 years) and very-oldest 10% (49–68 years).

n.sample_role: Participants in the two mutually exclusive final extreme-age groups in this t-test.
n.exclusions: USA final sample after attention checks, valid demographic responses and estimated woman age older than 18 years; non-USA respondents excluded. Recruitment: 666 overall, 418 USA; final USA sample 393. Middle-age participants excluded from this contrast.

notes: Identity independently verified in canonical text: matching title Perception of an ambiguous figure is affected by own-age social biases; authors Michael E. R. Nicholls, Owen Churches and Tobias Loetscher; Scientific Reports 8, 12661 (2018); DOI 10.1038/s41598-018-31129-7. Primary published article with Method, Results and Discussion, not abstract-only. No PDF supplied; locations refer to canonical HTML sections. Replication side and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. 40 + 45 = 85 participants. Explicit final groups ages 18–22 and 49–68 are mutually exclusive; USA eligibility/exclusions apply, middle ages omitted. Not inferred from df. Youngest/oldest description identifies this contrast independently of numeric matching or row order. Printed p retained without recalculation.
